verdict.rationale: Docs and community reports confirm Lovable generates full-stack apps (frontend, backend/database/auth) from a single prompt, e.g. describing data creates tables/schema, asking for login wires backend auth with RLS, and the built-in Cloud backend provides database, auth, storage, and functions without separate setup; community users corroborate using it to get 'login system and database' quickly. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark verifying backend code quality/robustness beyond a documented access-control bug in one case.
